profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer / PLC Developer
profile.jobTitle: Embedded Software Engineer / PLC Developer IV

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer / PLC Developer IV
positions.description:
• Created Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) in FactoryTalk Optix and FactoryTalk View for monitoring and control of autonomous maritime vehicles.
    • Updated PLC Logic and Tags to reflect changes in the hardware and controls.
    • Wrote software in python for serial communication, timing, and emergency state changes and tested software on hardware prototype. 
    • Wrote software requirements to ensure and verify the fulfillment of system level requirements.
    • Updated and tested network communication for remote operation of vehicle systems. 
    • Used Virtual Machines (VMs) for software development and testing across Windows and Linux OSes.
    • Wrote reports and created slides for presentation for the customer proposing design for project.
    • Selected and ordered parts for upcoming development projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Test Equipment · Systems Engineering · Object-oriented Languages

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote software in C and C++ to develop embedded software application systems and device
drivers in accordance with design requirements. Application functions included data processing
and communication in ARINC 429 protocol, ethernet, RS-485, and RS-422, all operating in real-
time OS VxWorks.
• Created design and requirements in DOORS for the Software Requirements Specifications and
the Software Design Documents for avionics embedded software applications and device
drivers.
• Used TortoiseSVN for code configuration management.
• Created, tracked, and scheduled work elements in Jira for Agile project management to meet
project objectives.
• Tested prototype code on test station, used troubleshooting to find and address any issues.
• Collaborated with team members to solve technical problems and meet project objectives while
ensuring separate aspects of application interfaced correctly.
• Prepared and presented both requirements and code in technical reviews.
• Wrote test cases to verify software requirements written would be met.
• Reviewed software documents for transition to Jama to verify requirements were met.
• Performed all software development in accordance with processes and the DO-178C standard.
positions.insights: Skills: DO-178B · Embedded Software · ARINC 429 · Ethernet · Linux · Software Development · Debugging · Systems Engineering · Object-oriented Languages

positions.title: Instrumentation/Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, assembly, and test for Ground Test Instrumentation used in rocket engines.
• Designed test equipment in AutoCAD, wrote manufacturing planning for wire harness build, tested and implemented Data Acquisition Systems including filters, amplifiers, and sensors, wrote engineering processes including calibration, linearity and hysteresis, reviewed engine test data in WinPlot and wrote Python scripts to streamline data review.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Test Equipment · AutoCAD · Sensors · Oscilloscope · Systems Engineering · Project Engineering

positions.title: Associate Electrical Engineer
positions.description: • Design, test, and manufacturing support for land and marine vehicle electrical systems, including power, user control, sensors, and CAN Bus.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Equipment · AutoCAD · CAN bus · wire harness

positions.title: Research And Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Research Assistant writing Master’s Thesis “Cyber-Physical Security Strategies” on defense of sensor & control system networks and Teaching Assistant for Digital Logic

positions.title: Naval Research Enterprise Intern
positions.description: • Programming in C++ and 3D Modeling in Blender of software package for control of a robotic arm with seven degrees of freedom using Robotic Operating System (ROS)
